purpose: Teach: 配付/減額/必需/構文/造る/充足/取消/買物

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、自ら社員に資料を配付された
lines.en: Your father — when he was building the company, he'd hand out materials to staff himself.
lines.style: Measured, respectful tone. Slow cadence, each phrase allowed to settle. Voice carries the weight of memory — not mournful, but reverent. Slight pause after the dash, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは無理な減額を社員に強いられなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never pushed unreasonable pay cuts onto his employees.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. A gentle correction that's also agreement — honoring the truth of what was. Warm but grounded. Not defensive, just clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、必需品を社員に提供されたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he made sure his staff had what they needed.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender. Voice lingers on the detail like it still matters. Slight breathiness, like the speaker is moved by the memory. Not performed emotion — genuine acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品名の構文にもこだわられた
lines.en: Yes. He was particular about everything — even how product names were written.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the second half. Light emphasis on 'everything' — not criticizing, but marveling at the thoroughness. Slow pace. The voice of someone who understood his father's care in the details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、人を信用で造る経営をされた
lines.en: Your father — he built his business on trust in people.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Each word deliberate, unhurried. The voice of someone offering this as wisdom, not just memory. Slight lift on 'trust' — it was the foundation. Trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の充足を最優先された
lines.en: Yes. He always put his employees' wellbeing first.
lines.style: Simple affirmation, weighted with understanding. Not emphatic, but firm in a gentle way. The voice of someone who learned this lesson and has carried it forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、契約の取消にも誠実に対応された
lines.en: Your father — he handled even contract cancellations with integrity.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. The detail itself becomes moral weight. Slow, respectful delivery. A slight catch in the voice — not sadness, but recognition of how rare this kindness was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の買物にも理解があった
lines.en: Yes. He understood what his staff needed, even in the small things.
lines.style: Closing with grace and finality. Warm, almost gentle at the edges. This voice carries the full weight of what was being passed down — a man's legacy lived through his smallest choices. Let it settle.
